findings.description: All 240 required people were classified individually. The pinned All Faculty directory has 240 entries and the faculty-dept core list has 116. By the directory's own categories they are: Faculty 88, Affiliates 87, Teaching or Instructors 21, Research Professors 5, Emeritus 23, Adjunct 16. Fresh GETs of the All Faculty and core lists, the Affiliates list, and the Qing Cao, Chet Gardner, Janak H Patel, Ryan Corey, Roy Dong and William S. Moses ECE profiles are byte-identical to the pinned captures.

Result: 174 included (88 regular, 84 affiliate_professor, 2 courtesy) and 66 excluded (23 emeritus, 21 teaching, 16 adjunct, 5 research_only, 1 departed); 0 unresolved. All 87 Affiliate Faculty directory entries were checked. The official Affiliate Faculty designation is recorded as affiliate_professor rather than joint_secondary unless the official profile states a more specific appointment (courtesy: Qing Cao, William S. Moses).

Excluded, departed. The UIC ECE profile (fetched fresh) names him an Assistant Professor of ECE at UIC, and the UIUC profile labels the Urbana-Champaign site as old and the UIC site as new. The UIUC Affiliate Faculty directory still lists him without a title or dates; this is treated as a stale directory entry, not a current UIUC ECE professorial appointment. A UIUC affiliate designation held alongside the UIC position cannot be ruled out from the pages alone.

Included, affiliate_professor. The UIUC ISE profile shows a current Assistant Professor appointment in ISE (August 2023 - present), and the official ECE Affiliate Faculty directory lists him. The earlier ECE Research Assistant Professor role ended August 2023 and was not used.
